title: Concept: Python index configured over cleartext
description: requirements.txt declares an index URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every artifact and every hash comparison travels unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different file and its matching hash.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Every artifact and every hash comparison travels unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different file and its matching hash.
